mapper.select: SELECT u.user_num, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.user_email, u.user_phone, u.user_gender, u.user_birth, u.user_address, u.user_status, -- 라이선스 테이블 조인 컬럼 (DTO 필드명에 맞춰 Alias 설정) l.license_type, l.license_num AS license_number, -- DB는 license_num, DTO는 license_number일 경우 l.license_end_date AS license_expiry, -- DB는 license_end_date, DTO는 license_expiry일 경우 l.license_birth AS license_birth_check -- 면허증상 생일 (필요시) FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN license l ON u.user_num = l.user_num WHERE u.user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET user_email = #{userEmail}, user_phone = #{userPhone}, user_gender = #{userGender}, user_birth = #{userBirth}, user_address = #{userAddress} WHERE user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.select: SELECT license_id, license_type, license_num, license_birth, license_date, license_end_date, license_region, user_num, license_photo_path, created_at, updated_at FROM license WHERE user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.update: UPDATE license SET license_type = #{licenseType}, license_num = #{licenseNum}, license_birth = #{licenseBirth}, license_date = #{licenseDate}, license_end_date = #{licenseEndDate}, license_region = #{licenseRegion}, license_photo_path = #{licensePhotoPath} WHERE user_num = #{userNum}
